summary: Iter 23 (approximate-price non-strict branch + priced-variant preference) VERIFIED green. All 5 new iter23 tests pass + 1 environmental skip; full regression 33/33 pass (2 expected skips). Key findings: (1) fetch_price_and_meta('Charizard', 'english', None, None) returns strict=False, price.market > 0 (real USD price from JustTCG), alt_matches populated (>=1 candidate) — confirms bug fix. (2) _best_variant_price correctly prefers priced variants: unit test with a Near-Mint variant (no price) vs Lightly-Played variant ($350) picks the priced one → market=350.0 (was None before). (3) Strict path regression: Pikachu Base 58 image → identified=true, name=Pikachu, number contains '58', price.market > 0, price_source has 'JustTCG · pokemon · Holofoil' (does NOT contain 'approximate'), ambiguous=false. ✅ (4) /api/scan-card/pick regression: {Pikachu, Base, 58} → 200, price.market > 0, price_source ends with ' · picked'. ✅ (5) Full regression suite: backend_test 9/9, collection 5/5, graded 4/4, iter16 non-strict 1/2 (1 skip), iter20 vision 3/3, iter21 image 2/2, iter22 candidate 4/4, iter23 5/5+1skip. Frontend: App loads at localhost:3000 with 0 console errors. Tutorial dismisses cleanly. All 4 tabs (SCANNER/COLLECTION/HISTORY/SETTINGS) navigate cleanly with no red screen. Settings page shows all required controls (Auto-scan, Min confidence, Haptics, Voice, Announce on lock, TTS voice, Session batch counter). No infinite render loops observed. Code review: index.tsx:645-651 correctly renders `approx-price-chip` testID when card.price_source matches /approximate/i (styled with colors.brand chipApprox + text 'APPROX PRICE'). index.tsx:682-686 correctly switches ambiguous-block header text to 'Pick the exact set for a confirmed price:' when approximate, else 'Same # exists in other sets — pick the correct printing:'. server.py:656-687 non-strict branch: has_price gate ensures price populated only when JustTCG returned a value; price_source suffixes ' · closest match · approximate'; reasoning starts with 'Approximate price shown'. Vision model unchanged: claude-sonnet-4-5 at server.py:171. Frontend approx-chip UI render couldn't be end-to-end tested in web preview (no camera capture path to trigger non-strict), but the JSX render logic is a straightforward regex check on price_source, verified against the API contract in the backend tests. Deprecation warnings still present (web-only: shadow*, pointerEvents) — same as iter22 report; not blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Console still emits 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Same as iter22 — web-only informational warnings from react-native-web shim; no functional impact on native. Not blocking.

action_items: (NONE required) All iter23 features work end-to-end. Optional: manual on-device verification of the `approx-price-chip` render (feed the app a real, hard-to-focus card image so the vision model can't read the number cleanly — the backend then returns price_source with 'approximate' and the brand-colored APPROX PRICE chip appears alongside the ambiguous-block picker). This flow is deterministic via the backend fetch_price_and_meta unit test but couldn't be exercised in the web preview without a live camera feed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:272-325 _best_variant_price — Now correctly restricts scoring to variants that have any usable price signal ('priced' pool) if at least one exists, otherwise falls back to full list. Also adds +40 score for variants with a `price` field so a Near-Mint-no-price variant can't beat a Lightly-Played-with-price. Result: market is populated whenever ANY variant is priced (was None before for Charizard Base). Fix is clean and backwards-compatible.

server.py:429-442 fetch_price_and_meta non-strict alt_matches — When not strict AND no same-number alternates were found, walks ranked[1:] gathering top distinct-set candidates (cap 4). This gives the frontend picker meaningful entries even when the user's number was unreadable. Set-based dedup via seen_sets is correct.

server.py:656-687 scan-card non-strict branch — has_price = approx_price and approx_price.market is not None; price only populated when has_price; price_source suffixed ' · closest match · approximate'; reasoning starts 'Approximate price shown — exact printing not confirmed. Tap a set below to lock the correct printing.' when has_price, else falls back to the older 'no exact price' message. Contract matches spec exactly.

server.py:611-633 candidates_list build — Consistent across strict AND non-strict branches (built once, used in both info=CardInfo(...) constructions). ambiguous=len(candidates_list)>0 in both. Good — no divergence risk.

index.tsx:645-651 approx-price-chip — Conditional on /approximate/i.test(card.price_source). Uses chipApprox (styles.chipApprox at line 986: border colors.brand, backgroundColor colors.surfaceTertiary) and chipApproxText (line 991: color colors.brand). testID='approx-price-chip'. Text 'APPROX PRICE'. Matches spec.

index.tsx:682-686 ambiguous-block header — Uses same regex on price_source to swap header text. When approximate → 'Pick the exact set for a confirmed price:'; else → 'Same # exists in other sets — pick the correct printing:'. Matches spec.

index.tsx:207-213 lock status message — 'Locked · price loaded' | 'Locked · no exact price match' | 'Locked · printing not confirmed'. Approximate case falls into 'price loaded' because result.price.market is now populated — clean UX; user is subsequently guided to the picker by the ambiguous-block.

success_rate.backend: 33/33 pass (100%), 2 expected skips (iter16 non_strict trusts-vision skip is environment-dependent; iter23 api_non_strict_via_low_res skip when vision reads number cleanly). All 5 iter23 core tests PASS.
success_rate.frontend: 100% for scope tested — App loads, tutorial + SKIP work, all 4 tabs navigate cleanly, Settings shows all controls, 0 console errors, no red screen. Approx-chip end-to-end render path not exercisable without live camera; JSX logic reviewed and matches contract.

seed_data_creation: None. Tests use idempotent JustTCG lookups and self-clean via /api/history clear.

Tap a set below to lock the correct printing.' Also improved _best_variant_price to prefer priced variants (fix for Charizard Base returning market=None). If future iters touch fetch_price_and_meta, note that alt_matches is populated on BOTH the 'same-number-different-sets' path AND the non-strict fallback path — the frontend renders both identically via ambiguous-block.
